title: FOUNDATIONAL AUTOMATIC EVALUATORS: SCALING MULTI-TASK GENERATIVE EVALUATOR TRAINING FOR REASONING-CENTRIC DOMAINS

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring evaluator consistency in pairwise benchmarks by swapping the order of candidate responses (Response A and Response B) and checking if the model changes its judgment.

Evaluating models on the RM-Bench benchmark, which tests evaluator robustness to subtle stylistic differences by comparing pairs of responses to see if the model incorrectly favors style over factual accuracy.
